name: JLC3DP
notes: Usually among the cheapest for small plastic parts. Ships worldwide from China, so delivery takes longer.

name: PCBWay 3D printing
notes: Low prices and handy if you also order a circuit board from them. Ships worldwide from China.

name: Craftcloud
notes: Compares quotes from many print services at once, so it's a quick way to find the cheapest option for your country.

name: Treatstock
notes: A marketplace of independent printers, some of them local, so shipping can be short.

name: Protolabs Network
notes: Formerly Hubs. Professional quality and engineering materials, priced for businesses.

name: Xometry
notes: Industrial printing with instant quotes. Best for strong or precise parts, not the cheapest for hobby parts.

name: Sculpteo
notes: Paris-based service with a wide choice of materials, including nylon that is tougher than PLA.
